column4: componentize-py and wasm-tools are not installed on this runner, and these two tests need a real Python guest: they drive poll_child, await_any_child and a pending-only await through the component boundary, which only executing one can show. Whole tests with no dialect arm, so this job's single DSN does not change the count. Measured on the Test MySQL job (run 40430580695, PR #3432 head bf70b1ff), which named exactly these two as the skips matching no ledger line; the SQL Server job runs the same unfiltered ./engine/... sweep without the toolchain, so the same two are declared there from that reading, not a separate measurement. Re-derive by name: grep '"Action":"skip"' test-report.json | grep -E 'TestPythonGuest(PollsAndRacesChildren|AwaitingOnlyPendingChildren)'. They run for real in scripts/docker/python-toolchain.Dockerfile, where the toolchain exists (measured there). (cleat#3390)
